message: I have designed a 4-slide deck for the Q3 data platform review. Each slide delivers one element of the argument against the resolved data.

deck_spec.title: Q3 Data Platform Review
deck_spec.purpose: Demonstrate the reliability and throughput gains from the unified pipeline rollout
deck_spec.argument: Migrating batch jobs to the streaming-first architecture cut end-to-end latency by 62% and eliminated two classes of data-loss incident.
deck_spec.call_to_action: Approve the Q4 budget to extend streaming coverage to the remaining three data domains.
narrative_arc: Before state: fragmented batch pipelines with known failure modes
Migration: what we changed and why it was safe to do incrementally
Results: latency, reliability, and cost figures with sources
Ask: what approval unlocks and what happens if deferred

resolved_data.synthesis: The streaming migration reduced median end-to-end latency from 4.8 h to 1.8 h (62%) and dropped data-loss incidents from 11 in H1 to 0 in Q3. Infrastructure cost per job fell 18% due to reduced reprocessing overhead. No single source covers all four metrics; synthesis across three sources is required.
gaps: Latency for the legacy domain has not yet been measured post-migration; it completed in week 9 of the quarter

slides.content_brief: Fragmented pipelines: 3 batch domains, average 4.8 h latency, 11 data-loss incidents in H1. Show the pipeline topology map.
slides.assumes: Audience knows what a data pipeline is but does not know our specific topology or incident history.
slides.hands_off: Establishes the baseline latency and incident count the results slide will reference.

slides.content_brief: Incremental domain-by-domain rollout over 9 weeks. Shadow mode first, cutover once parity proven. No big-bang risk.
slides.assumes: Audience understands the before-state problem from slide 0.
slides.hands_off: Primes the audience to expect hard numbers on the results slide.

slides.purpose: Show the results with sourced figures
slides.content_brief: 62% latency reduction, 0 incidents in Q3, 18% cost-per-job reduction. Side-by-side before/after table with source attributions.
slides.assumes: Audience has seen the before-state and migration approach slides.
slides.hands_off: Provides the evidence base for the investment ask on slide 3.

slides.purpose: State the ask and the cost of deferral
slides.content_brief: Q4 budget to migrate remaining 3 domains. Timeline: 12 weeks. Risk of deferral: re-exposure to the incident classes we just eliminated.
slides.assumes: Audience trusts the results evidence and understands the migration model.
slides.hands_off: Final slide; no subsequent slide receives a hand-off.
